title: DROP-IN: A TEAMMATE CAN JOIN A RAID ALREADY UNDER WAY
why: His pick from the feature list. A teammate in the Undercroft while the host is up top gets a JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS button. It asks the host, which answers with its raid, the clock, the time left, where it stands and the bodies already down; the teammate builds the same surface, drops those bodies, takes the clock and comes up beside the host. Dropping out is as before.
now: DROP-IN, his pick from the feature list: a teammate in the Undercroft while the host is up top gets JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS; the host answers with its raid, clock, time left, position and the bodies already down, and the teammate comes up beside it on the same surface. Dropping out is as before.
